links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT prompt with no reading-level instruction (standard level responses)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level) versus accuracy and appropriateness of ChatGPT responses
links.effect: Sixth-grade prompt lowered the Flesch-Kincaid grade from 14.06 to 8.48, matching OrthoInfo (8.98, no significant difference). Accuracy fell to 3.9 ± 0.87 vs 4.7 ± 0.43 (p = 0.046) and appropriateness to 3.7 ± 0.92 vs 4.7 ± 0.45 (p = 0.045).
links.tradeoff: The sixth-grade responses were oversimplified and less accurate and less appropriate than standard responses.
links.quote: ChatGPT's responses at the sixth-grade level scored lower in accuracy (mean = 3.9 ± 0.87, p = 0.046) and appropriateness (mean = 3.7 ± 0.92, p = 0.045) compared to the standard level (accuracy = 4.7 ± 0.43, appropriateness = 4.7 ± 0.45).
